## About
South Shore Plumbing & Heating Supply Co is a plumbing and heating supply house on S Exchange Ave in Chicago. We carry plumbing parts along with steam and hot water boiler parts and supplies.
One reviewer named John and his son Lance, and said the crew treats customers like family and is always willing to help with questions. Another said his father started doing business with us, and he still does today.
Stop by the counter on weekdays or Saturday morning, or give us a call before you make the drive.

## Services
- Steam and hot water boiler parts: Parts and supplies for steam and hot water boilers. One reviewer, a heating contractor, called us the place to go for them.
- Plumbing: One reviewer said that if it's plumbing related, you will find it here.
